info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Enterprise Architecture Insights API
info.description: The Enterprise Architecture Insights API facilitates access to essential architectural frameworks and strategic business directions within the banking domain. It enables users to retrieve detailed insights regarding the enterprise architecture, promoting informed decision-making and alignment with organizational goals. This API is valuable for business analysts, architects, and strategic planners who require a comprehensive understanding of the architectural landscape to drive business outcomes. By leveraging this API, stakeholders can efficiently assess and visualize the impact of architectural decisions on business performance.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed information about the enterprise architecture, providing insights into its structure and components. It is essential for understanding the alignment between business strategy and IT capabilities.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving enterprise architecture information, including various operations related to business direction.
